chapter: Records, Jimmy Wade and Richard M. Jones
title: The Punch Miller Stompers tunes and Artie Stalk
summary: Allen reads tunes from the discography; Punch confirms.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: Well, let's see. Do these tunes sound familiar now? West End Blues?
That's right. Boy in the Boat?
Sugarfoot Stomp? That's right. Muscle Shoals Blues?
That's right. I played them with him.
And that's with Richard M. Jones? That's right. The band is called Punch Miller Stompers.
I got the Charles Zaloni new hot discography. I looked it up.
Well, he must have been no reason for him.
Well, let's see. Artie Stalk on clarinet?
Who did he work with, Artie Stalk?
Well, he just was a fellow along there working with different bands and things.
Yeah, I mean, you didn't work with him much.
No, he didn't play in my band.
